chunks: Faḍālah narrated from Dāwūd ibn Abī Yazīd, who said: I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام say:

Indeed, the companions of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to Saʿd ibn ʿUbādah, ‘Tell us, if you found a man with your wife, what would you do to him?’ He said, ‘I would strike him with the sword.’ He said: Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله came out and said, ‘What is this, O Saʿd?’ Saʿd said, ‘They said to me: If you found a man with your wife, what would you do to him? So I said: I would strike him with the sword.’ So he said, ‘O Saʿd, then what about four [witnesses]?’ He said, ‘O Messenger of Allah, even after the sight of my own eye and Allah’s knowledge that he has indeed done it?’ He said, ‘Yes, by Allah, even after the sight of your own eye and Allah’s knowledge that he has indeed done it, because Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has set for everything a limit, and He has set for the one who transgresses that limit a limit.’

key_terms.بِأَرْبَعَةٍ: the requirement of four witnesses in establishing the offense
key_terms.تَعَدَّى ذَلِكَ الْحَدَّ: to overstep the divinely fixed legal boundary
key_terms.حَدًّا: a prescribed legal limit or punishment set by Allah
key_terms.رَأْيِ عَيْنِكَ: direct personal sight or eyewitness seeing

ai.seo_question: Can a husband punish an adulterer himself if he sees him with his wife?
ai.summary: This hadith states that personal certainty, even direct sight, does not authorize an individual to bypass the divinely established legal process. The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله affirms that accusations of adultery are governed by fixed limits and evidentiary requirements, and that transgressing those limits is itself subject to punishment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.4992 - Faḍalah narrated from Dawud ibn Abi Yazid who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (as) say: "

The companions of the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) said to Saʿd ibn Ubadah, 'What would you do if you found a man with your wife?'
He (Sa'd) replied: 'I would strike him with the sword.'
Then the Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace be upon him and his family) came out and said:
'What is this, O' Saʿd?'
Saʿd said: 'They asked me what I would do if I found a man with my wife, and I said I would strike him with the sword.'
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'O' Saʿd, but what about the requirement of four witnesses?'
Saʿd replied: 'O' Messenger of Allah (swt), even after seeing it with my own eyes and knowing, as Allah (swt) knows, that it has happened?'
The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Yes, by Allah (swt), even after you see it with your own eyes and Allah (swt) knows it has happened, because Allah (swt), the Glorious and Exalted, has set limits for everything, and for whoever transgresses these limits, Allah (swt) has also prescribed a punishment.'"
